Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses a specialized isobaric labeling strategy (iqPIR) for cross-linking proteomics. While it is 'isobaric' in nature, it does not fit standard TMT/iTRAQ categories as it uses custom peptide-based cross-linkers with specific isotope offsets for fragment ions. Acquisition is DDA based on the mention of 'tandem MS analysis' and 'precursor ion' selection typical of the Q Exactive HF instrument used.

scope: In order to test the reproducibility of 6-plex iqPIR quantitation on a complex sample, HeLa cells were grown in tissue culture and separately treated with each isobaric cross-linker.
HeLa cells from six different confluent 150 mm culture dishes were crosslinked individually with each of the six isobaric iqPIR crosslinkers
The crosslinked cells were pelleted by centrifugation at 300 × g for 3 min and washed 3 times with PBS 1×. This was followed by LC-MS analysis and data analysis.
